title: discord.notify input
description: One egress status notification for the owner-paired Discord channel (LIFE-001). R2: the post is outbound but scoped to the configured owner-paired channel and composed from subscribed real EventBus/LiveEventStream state — never synthesized. message is the bounded status text; the egress scrub pass strips sensitive tokens before transport, and credentials, tokens, and unpaired channel targets never travel in arguments — routing comes only from adapter configuration. A missing notify bridge or unpaired channel is typed unavailable, never a silent drop.
